Of the advisor
  
  
Of the Branch.

title: Center Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Medcity International Academy (MIA) is a premier professional training and coaching institution headquartered in Kannur, Kerala, India, with multiple centers across Kerala and Karnataka. It is recognized as a leading provider of English language proficiency and professional assessment test training, focusing on international exam success and global employability. MIA delivers high-impact preparatory programs for a wide range of language tests and healthcare licensure exams, supported by experienced and globally certified trainers. The Academy combines evidence-based teaching methods, digital tools, personalized coaching, language labs, mock examinations, and app-based learning to support both online and classroom learners. Its mission is to expand global opportunities for professionals and students across healthcare, IT, engineering, hospitality, aviation, tourism, and communications through impactful education and strategic training.

**Role Description**
The Center Manager is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the Medcity International Academy center in Thrissur in a full-time, on-site capacity. This role includes managing academic and administrative activities, supervising staff and trainers, and ensuring that classes, assessments, and student support services run smoothly. The Center Manager will monitor student enrollment, engagement, and outcomes, coordinate schedules and resources, and maintain high standards of service quality and learner satisfaction. This position also involves implementing institutional policies, reporting performance metrics, supporting marketing and outreach initiatives, and liaising with headquarters and other centers to ensure alignment with MIA’s mission and standards.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong center and operations management skills, including staff supervision, scheduling, resource allocation, and process improvement.
* Candidates should possess solid people management and leadership abilities, with experience in team coordination, performance monitoring, and conflict resolution.
* Candidates should possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills for interacting with students, families, trainers, and external stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess customer service and student support skills, with a focus on learner satisfaction, guidance, and issue resolution.
* Candidates should possess basic financial and administrative skills, including budgeting oversight, reporting, and adherence to institutional policies.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with educational or training environments, preferably in language proficiency, test preparation, or healthcare/professional training.
* Relevant academic qualification such as a bachelor’s degree in management, education, business administration, or a related field is preferred.
* Proficiency in using digital tools, learning management platforms, and office software, along with the ability to adapt to new technologies, is beneficial.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment are essential.

title: Associate / Sr Associate Human Resource
description:
**Company Description**
CGH Earth Experience Hotels is a pioneer of sustainable and responsible tourism in India, known for curating distinctive, place-based experiences. The group operates on core values of working closely with local communities, respecting local culture, and caring for the environment. CGH Earth and its properties have received multiple national and international awards for responsible tourism, sustainability, wellness, culinary excellence, and heritage hospitality. Recognitions from organizations such as National Geographic, World Travel Mart, Outlook Traveller, and various tourism bodies highlight CGH Earth’s leadership in environmentally sensitive and experiential travel. Team members joining CGH Earth work in an award-winning environment that blends hospitality with strong social and ecological purpose.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Associate / Sr Associate Human Resource role based in Alappuzha. The role involves supporting day-to-day HR operations, including maintaining employee records, assisting in recruitment and onboarding, and coordinating employee lifecycle processes. The individual will help implement HR policies, administer employee benefits, and support compliance with relevant labor and company regulations. Daily responsibilities include responding to employee queries, coordinating HR documentation, assisting with performance management and training initiatives, and supporting employee engagement and welfare activities. The role requires close collaboration with hotel operations teams to ensure HR processes are consistently applied and aligned with CGH Earth’s values.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Human Resources (HR) and HR Management.
* Candidates should possess solid knowledge of HR Policies and their practical implementation.
* Candidates should possess experience in Employee Benefits and Benefits Administration.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Working knowledge of Indian labor laws, HR compliance, and standard HR tools or HRIS systems.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and conflict-resolution skills, with an ability to work with diverse teams.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to handle confidential information responsibly.
* Prior experience in hospitality or service-oriented industries is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**1. Job Overview**

**Lead the complete human resources function across Regal Jewellers’ corporate offices, regional offices and showrooms. Build a structured, accountable and technology-enabled HR department that supports business growth, workforce productivity, employee engagement and statutory compliance. Partner with the CEO, General Managers, Regional Managers, Department Heads and Showroom Managers.**

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**HR Strategy & Organisational Development**

**• Develop HR strategy aligned with business objectives and expansion plans.**

**• Define HR organisation structure, reporting relationships, approval matrices and accountability.**

**• Prepare manpower plans, annual HR budgets and succession plans.**

**• Standardise HR practices across offices, regions and showrooms.**

**Recruitment & Manpower Planning**

**• Own recruitment strategy for corporate, regional and showroom positions.**

**• Maintain approved headcount, vacancy tracking and hiring turnaround times.**

**• Govern sourcing, screening, interviews, selection, offers and onboarding.**

**• Monitor recruitment budgets, cost per hire, talent pipelines and probation confirmation.**

**HR Operations & Administration**

**• Oversee employee lifecycle from onboarding through separation.**

**• Maintain accurate employee master records and employment documentation.**

**• Govern transfers, promotions, designation and department changes.**

**• Monitor attendance, shifts, weekly offs, leave, overtime and field attendance.**

**• Implement standard workflows, approvals and regional HR audits.**

**Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

**• Oversee accurate, on-time payroll, incentives, overtime, reimbursements and deductions.**

**• Coordinate payroll reconciliation and approvals with Finance and Accounts.**

**• Manage compensation structures, salary reviews, benefits and payroll budgets.**

**• Ensure timely full-and-final settlements and compensation confidentiality.**

**Employee Performance Management**

**• Define KRAs and KPIs for departments and employee categories.**

**• Implement appraisals, probation assessments and performance improvement plans.**

**• Review productivity, absenteeism, performance gaps and workforce utilisation.**

**• Support evidence-based promotions, increments and recognition.**

**HR Policies & Governance**

**• Develop employee handbook, HR policies and standard operating procedures.**

**• Govern attendance, leave, shifts, overtime, conduct, discipline and approvals.**

**• Communicate policy changes and ensure consistent implementation.**

**• Review policy compliance, exceptions and management escalations.**

**Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws**

**• Ensure compliance with applicable laws in Kerala, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.**

**• Oversee PF, ESI, gratuity, professional tax and applicable wage/working-hour requirements.**

**• Maintain statutory filings, registrations, renewals and inspection records.**

**• Coordinate audits, corrective actions, legal advisors and workplace harassment prevention obligations.**

**HRMS & Digital Transformation**

**• Lead adoption and continuous improvement of RegalSoft HRMS.**

**• Maintain employee master data and workflows for attendance, leave, payroll, incentives and performance.**

**• Coordinate IT integrations, role-based access, audit trails and data security.**

**• Introduce automated dashboards and train HR teams and employees.**

**Employee Relations & Engagement**

**• Manage grievances, disciplinary matters and conflict resolution fairly and consistently.**

**• Develop employee engagement, recognition, retention and welfare initiatives.**

**• Review attrition, exit interviews and employee feedback.**

**• Advise managers on employee relations and workplace culture.**

**Training & Development**

**• Assess training needs across corporate and showroom operations.**

**• Plan induction, sales, service, leadership and operational training.**

**• Measure training completion and effectiveness.**

**• Develop internal talent and succession pipelines.**

**Regional & Showroom HR Management**

**• Oversee regional HR implementation and showroom staffing.**

**• Coordinate with Regional and Showroom Managers on attendance, discipline and performance.**

**• Conduct regional audits and resolve escalated HR issues.**

**• Support manpower mobilisation for new showroom openings.**

**HR Budgeting, Analytics & Reporting**

**• Prepare and track HR budgets, employee costs and recruitment expenditure.**

**• Publish monthly HR dashboards for hiring, attendance, attrition, payroll and performance.**

**• Review regional manpower utilisation and cost optimisation opportunities.**

**• Present risks, corrective actions and HR performance to CEO / Management.**

**3. Key Result Areas & Performance Indicators**

**KRA**

**KPI**

**Recruitment**

**Vacancy closure time; hiring plan achievement; cost per hire**

**Manpower**

**Approved vs actual headcount; vacancy percentage**

**HR Operations**

**Transaction turnaround time; employee data accuracy**

**Attendance**

**Compliance; absenteeism; unresolved exceptions**

**Payroll**

**Payroll accuracy; on-time processing**

**Retention**

**Attrition rate; critical employee retention**

**Performance**

**On-time performance review completion**

**HRMS**

**Adoption; data accuracy; workflow compliance**

**Compliance**

**Timely filings; audit issue closure**

**Employee Relations**

**Grievance resolution turnaround time**

**Training**

**Completion and effectiveness**

**Budget**

**Actual expenditure vs approved budget**

**Targets are to be agreed and approved by management based on operational requirements.**

**4. Qualifications & Experience**

**• MBA / Master’s degree in HR, Personnel Management or related discipline.**

**• 12–15 years of progressive HR experience, including 5 years in leadership.**

**• Experience managing multi-location HR operations; retail/jewellery experience preferred.**

**• Strong command of HRMS, payroll, employee performance and applicable employment regulations.**

**5. Core Competencies**

**Strategic HR leadership; organisational planning; talent acquisition; policy design; statutory compliance; payroll governance; employee relations; HRMS transformation; analytics; budget control; communication; confidentiality and integrity.**

**6. Reporting & Accountability**

**Reports to the CEO / Management. Collaborates with General Managers, Department Heads, Regional Managers, Showroom Managers, Finance, IT, Administration and HR teams. Accountable for the effectiveness, compliance and measurable performance of the HR function.**

**7. Expected Outcomes**

**1. A clearly structured HR department with defined ownership and reporting.**

**2. Standardised policies and efficient employee lifecycle processes across regions.**

**3. Improved recruitment turnaround, retention and workforce productivity.**

**4. Reliable payroll, attendance and statutory compliance.**

**5. Successful RegalSoft HRMS adoption and accurate management dashboards.**

**6. Measurable HR KPIs, governance and accountability.**

title: Assistant Manager Learning & Development
description:
**Job Description**
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive team member training and development programs to enhance team skills and performance; assessing training needs, designing and updating training courses to ensure that the training content matches the team members' job responsibilities and career paths; managing training budgets to ensure maximum return on training investment. As an
**Assistant Manager Learning & Development**
, you’re not just managing training initiatives for hotel team members – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
  
  

* Develop training programs: Design, plan, and deliver hotel training programs in alignment with corporate goals and industry standards, inclusive of topics such as harassment-free workplace, diversity, new team member orientation, leadership, and service
* Monitor and review performance: Conduct meetings with department managers, trainers, and team members to review performance trends, develop action plans, and recognize achievements
* Deliver continuous improvement: Assess existing training initiatives, identify opportunities for enhancement, and recommend solutions to address specific department needs
* Manage training records: Track, maintain, and audit individual team member training records using designated systems and tools
* Oversee departmental training programs: Manage and monitor department-specific training programs such as alcohol awareness, food safety, job skills checklists, and educational assistance
* Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

**Qualifications**
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
  
  
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
  
  
**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum 3 years in L&D or HR, with a strong track record in designing, delivering, and evaluating training programs.
* Degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Hospitality Management, or related field preferred.
* Skilled in instructional design, adult learning principles, and modern training methods (e.g., e-learning, blended learning).
* Proficient in assessing training effectiveness and aligning programs with business goals.
* Experienced with Learning Management Systems (LMS), digital training tools, and Microsoft Office.
* Strong verbal and written skills; able to engage and motivate diverse teams.
* Committed to continuous learning and staying updated on emerging training trends.
* Proven ability to work cross-functionally to identify needs and support performance improvement.
* Capable of managing training teams and multiple projects effectively.

**About Us**
**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
  
  
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
  
  
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
  
  
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Resourcing Manager
description:
We are a specialist data consultancy helping organisations unlock the true value of their data. Our work spans AI readiness strategy, data literacy, real-time reporting, and data management through mergers and acquisitions.

We are looking for an experienced Resourcing Manager to join our growing team and take ownership of "casting" the right data professionals onto the right client projects.

**About the role**

You will act as the bridge between our bench of consultants and live client engagements — matching skills, experience and culture to project requirements and ensuring we can deploy quickly and confidently.

**Key responsibilities**

* Match data professionals to client projects based on technical fit, client culture and project objectives.
* Build and maintain accurate role profiles reflecting required skills and experience.
* Manage a bench of available consultants in collaboration with our consulting capabilities team.
* Coordinate consultant transitions between assignments with project managers.
* Manage relationships with third-party partners to ensure talent is lined up against demand.
* Produce regular reports and metrics using casting and talent data; attend weekly standup's.
* Report directly into the Head of Talent & Casting.

**Requirement**

* 5+ years of experience in technical recruitment, resource management, preferably within data, technology, or consultancy sectors. If the person has contractor recruitment this would be preferable.
* Demonstrated understanding of data roles, skills, and technologies (e.g., data science, machine learning, data engineering, analytics).
* Strong knowledge of the UK data talent market and competitive landscape.
* Excellent networking abilities and relationship-building skills.

**Skills**

* Experience with Resourcing Planning Systems – Kantata Preferable.
* Experience of working and managing third party resources to supply demand.
* Experience with Hubspot Preferable.
* Advanced Excel and Office Suite.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Experience working with UK clients/stakeholders.

title: HR Generalist
description:
Alpha Drop Ventures is building the standard layer for cultural commerce. At the center is DROPZ, our core platform. Around it sit the brands we build and own, each one setting the bar for what credible culture\-led product looks like. We are pre\-launch and raising. The people joining now could be doing easier things elsewhere. They're choosing this instead. We need someone to own the people side of the company as it gets built.
   

  

**The Role**
 You own hiring and HR end to end. Finding the right people, running the process that filters them properly, getting them set up, and building the policies and culture systems that hold the team together as we grow. This is not a support role. You initiate, you own, and you drive.
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end recruitment across roles, from sourcing and screening to coordinating assessments, interviews, and offer communication
* Build and run a clean onboarding process so every new hire understands the standard, the systems, and the culture from day one
* Design and maintain HR policies that are legally sound, fair, and specific to how this company actually operates, not generic templates
* Build team culture and internal engagement through structured, intentional activities, not ad hoc gestures
* Handle core HR operations including documentation, compliance, and employee lifecycle processes from onboarding through separation
* Maintain accurate hiring and HR data, tracking pipeline status, headcount, and process gaps so decisions are made on real information
* Build and improve HR infrastructure as the team scales, including screening frameworks, policy documentation, and internal systems


**What This Actually Is**
 This is a founding team role. That means more than a title.
   

  

* You are not filling seats or running a checklist. You are building the people function of the company from the ground up. The decisions you make now become how this company operates for years
* You will work across hiring and HR operations simultaneously, switching context quickly without dropping quality on either side
* Feedback is direct and unfiltered. You hear clearly when something is off and when it lands, and you are expected to handle both calmly
* You will help define how Alpha Drop hires, onboards, and operates before there is a mature HR function to lean on. That is the rare part of this role and the demanding part


 If you want a narrow scope where hiring and HR are two separate people's jobs, this is the wrong room, and that is fine.
   

  

**How We Build And What Sets You Apart**
 We are here to build something, not make noise around something. We hold a high bar and we hold it together. The role gets you hired. This is what makes you matter here.
   

  

* You treat candidate quality and employee experience as your personal standard, not a metric someone else tracks
* You spot the gap in a process, a policy, or a pipeline before anyone asks about it, and you already have a plan to fix it
* You give candidates and employees a clear and honest experience throughout, because how we hire and how we treat people is part of how we are known
* You build things that outlast the task. Policies, frameworks, and systems, not just resolved tickets
* No passive feedback, no dropped context, no low effort with an excuse attached
* When a deadline is at risk, you raise it early. When a hire is not the right fit or a policy is not working, you say it clearly and fix it
* You protect the standard across every part of the people function, because one weak hire or one broken policy affects the whole team
* Going above and beyond is not about hours. It is about caring more precisely than the task requires, and building people systems like the team will be judged by them for years


**Who You Are**
* Minimum 18 months in HR, talent acquisition, or a combined people operations role, with proven ownership of both hiring and core HR activities
* Able to run end\-to\-end recruitment independently, from sourcing through offer, without needing the process handed to you
* Experienced in building or managing HR policy, documentation, and employee lifecycle processes in a real operating environment
* Strong written and verbal communicator who can represent the company well to candidates and employees alike
* Organised with pipelines, records, and processes, keeping everything visible and current without being reminded
* Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and decisions made on incomplete information, then refining from feedback and results
* Genuinely interested in people and culture building, not just process execution. You want to shape how a high\-standard company hires, onboards, and operates


 Build with us. Do not perform for us.
